title: Pamtech says ransomware hit its business system servers and personal data may have leaked
date_note: Boannews reports Pamtech detected the ransomware attack on 23 November; the company's notice was posted on 25 November.
geo_basis: country as the source states it; no city given
summary: Boannews reports that KOSDAQ-listed Pamtech, a maker of camera modules and semiconductor process automation equipment, detected a ransomware attack on its business system servers on 23 November. Pamtech's notice says personal information may have been leaked through unauthorized external access, and that no actual leak has been confirmed so far. Data possibly affected is shareholder and employee details.
plain: Pamtech says a ransomware attack hit its business servers and personal data may have leaked. The company says no actual leak has been confirmed so far.
exec: Pamtech says shareholder and current and former employee data may have been exposed; it has reported the incident to the data protection regulator and KISA.
action: No action needed; for awareness. Pamtech says it will give details again if the investigation confirms a leak.

validation.note: One publisher (Boannews) quoting Pamtech's own notice; the notice itself was not opened.
